source.title: Scrambling Program Update 0.8.2
source.content:
TNoodle 0.8.2 is now available from [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles)

This addresses the following compared to TNoodle 0.8.0:

- 2x2x2 scrambles only use `<R, U, F>` moves again.
- Regenerating scrambles preserves the order of rounds.
- A bug for merging consecutive moves has been fixed. (This does not affect randomness, but redundant turns may look confusing to scramblers at a competition.)
<!--break-->

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)

translation.title: 打乱程序更新：TNoodle 0.8.2
translation.content:
TNoodle 0.8.2 现已可从 [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles) 下载。

与 TNoodle 0.8.0 相比，本次修复包括：

* 二阶打乱恢复为只使用 R、U、F 转动。
* 重新生成打乱时保持轮次顺序不变。
* 修复了合并连续转动时的错误。该问题不影响随机性，但多余的转动可能让比赛中的打乱员感到困惑。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)
